title: PRD WU — Conversation Core Wireup
notes: Cleanup + wire-up sprint. Three of the six CCS stories shipped dead code in src/decider.py; live pipeline only uses GeneratorProcessor. This sprint bridges CCS-05a/05b into production, removes dead code, fixes one CI flake. Branch: s2s-realtime, layer commits on b2783e5 base. SHORT mode + 4 consensus execution conditions (EC-1..EC-4) locked in plan file.

stories.title: Pin wallclock in test_notify_dispatches_to_all_enabled_backends
stories.description: tests/test_indication.py::test_notify_dispatches_to_all_enabled_backends fails between 22:00–07:00 local because Indication() doesn't get a wallclock= kwarg, so quiet hours (default 22:00–07:00) suppress the sound backend. Sibling test_per_kind_toggle_disables_individual_backend at line 117 already pins wallclock to 12:00 — same author, just forgot.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_indication.py:84 passes wallclock=lambda: dt.datetime(2026, 4, 24, 12, 0) to Indication(...).
uv run pytest tests/test_indication.py::test_notify_dispatches_to_all_enabled_backends -q exits 0 regardless of wall-clock time.
uv run pytest tests/test_indication.py -q exits 0 (no regressions).
uv run ruff check tests/test_indication.py exits 0.

stories.title: Wire CCS-05b kill paths into the live cancel path
stories.description: src/generator.py:404 currently calls self.intent_queue.cancel_latest() (drops one queued intent only, leaves in-flight running). Replace with await self.intent_queue.cancel_active() so ActionWorker.cancel_in_flight() fires (subprocess SIGTERM via os.killpg, httpx cancel, SDK kill, TTS fade-out). EC-1: INTENT_CANCELLED indication must fire EXACTLY ONCE per cancel utterance (single emit site is src/actions.py:233); the generator's manual notify block at lines 408-415 must be deleted in the same commit.
acceptanceCriteria: src/generator.py:404 calls `await self.intent_queue.cancel_active()` (not cancel_latest).
src/generator.py:408-415 manual `INTENT_CANCELLED` notify block is deleted.
Unit test uses Mock/spy on Indication.notify and asserts call_count == 1 for IndicationKind.INTENT_CANCELLED over the cancel-path with 2 queued + 1 in-flight intents.
Integration test: when generator receives a transcript matching a stop-word and a long-running bash subprocess is in flight, the subprocess is killed within 3s of the cancel.
Empty queue + no in-flight cancel still produces NO indication notify call (cancel_active returns False; nothing to notify about).

uv run ruff check src/generator.py tests/test_generator.py tests/test_actions.py exits 0.

stories.title: Promote smart stop-word detector + DELETE check_cancel
stories.description: Move _is_standalone_cancel_imperative from src/decider.py:229 to src/language.py (next to where check_cancel currently lives). Update src/generator.py:403 to call the new function with self.settings.cancel_stop_words. EC-2: check_cancel and the CANCEL_PATTERNS dict MUST be deleted from src/language.py — no escape hatch. The smarter detector replaces the keyword-list match: ≤4-word imperatives only, negation guard ('don't stop' rejected), context guard ('stop sign' rejected).
acceptanceCriteria: _is_standalone_cancel_imperative is defined in src/language.py with the same signature and logic as currently in src/decider.py:229.
src/generator.py:403 calls _is_standalone_cancel_imperative(transcript, self.settings.cancel_stop_words) instead of check_cancel.
check_cancel function and CANCEL_PATTERNS dict are DELETED from src/language.py (EC-2: not 'preferred' — deleted).
grep -rn 'check_cancel\|CANCEL_PATTERNS' src/ returns zero matches.
tests/fixtures/cancel_stopwords.txt fixture-driven tests are migrated to test the new src/language.py location and exercise the production hot path.
All consensus-mandated false-positive cases ('don't stop the recording', 'stop is a four-letter word', 'no no no stop', 'ok stop stop', 'hey, please cancel') behave correctly.

stories.title: Remove HeartbeatTask + delete HEARE_HEARTBEAT_MIN env override (Option A)
stories.description: GeneratorProcessor.on_heartbeat_tick (src/generator.py:560-562) is a no-op. HeartbeatTask in src/heartbeat.py:25-52 ticks every N min and calls into a no-op. No user demand for proactive speech; legacy DeciderProcessor's heartbeat behaviour was reportedly chatty. Delete HeartbeatTask, the on_heartbeat_tick stub, the heartbeat_interval_minutes Setting field, and the HEARE_HEARTBEAT_MIN env override block at src/config.py:401-406. EC-4: PR body must explicitly call out HEARE_HEARTBEAT_MIN as a removed env var so deployment owners can clean their .env.

stories.title: Delete tests/test_decider.py + most of src/decider.py with shim semantics
